Scenario assumptions — not field validation
SYNTHETIC INPUTS USED HERE — The Period Components export does not provide channel units/locations or air temperature. Channel groups below are unverified scenario assignments and irradiance is interpreted as W/m². Temperature-dependent outputs use supplemental typical-year air temperature, not measured temperatures from the irradiance year; crop-cycle fresh-mass equivalents also use an assumed 5% dry-matter fraction. Unrecorded irradiance timestamps are assumed to have zero light. Crop biomass values are uncalibrated model-derived scenario estimates, not validated yields: the growth equation, channel units, and dry-matter conversion are not calibrated for this site. Each cycle starts at sowing; the GDD clock runs the nursery (sowing-to-transplant) stage without field biomass, and the biomass equation runs only from transplant to harvest, starting from the measured seedling fresh mass. Known limitation: the biomass equation gains more dry mass in cool air, opposite to measured lettuce growth, so cool-season values may be overstated. The final cycle may be incomplete. These are scenario outputs, not observed harvests or independent field validation. In this run the pipeline temperature input was TMY climatological air temperature from tmy_air_temperature.csv, UTC month/day/hour mapped to local standard-time hours (23.8°C), and the crop-cycle calculations use the same series. Modeled crop-cycle estimates (uncalibrated)

Fresh-mass equivalent = modeled field dry mass at harvest (including the transplanted seedling) divided by the assumed 5% dry-matter fraction. The GDD clock sets cycle duration (Days = sowing to harvest, including the nursery stage); field biomass is simulated only from transplant to harvest. The per-plant conversion uses the configured 96 plants over 11.25 m². For context only, values are compared with the user-reported 100–300 g/plant range; those records are not currently available for calibration. These are not measured or validated harvests.
